label: rem:brings-surface-def-remark
title: Genus, automorphisms and Euler characteristic of Bring's surface
html: Over any algebraically closed field K \supseteq R, Bring's surface \Sigma_4 is a smooth projective curve of genus 4. Its automorphism group is \mathrm{Aut}(\Sigma_4) \cong S_5. It has order 120, the maximum possible for genus 4, though below the Hurwitz bound 84(g-1) = 252. Its Euler characteristic is \chi(\Sigma_4) = 2 - 2g = -6.
